name: Trondonian
description: One of the three closely related peoples of Koplin 3. Trondonian ancestral physiology is adapted to hot, humid environments, while their historical cultures developed strong traditions in stewardship, biological management, food science and water systems.

name: Zoran
description: One of the three closely related peoples of Koplin 3. Zoran history was strongly shaped by accessible ores, metallurgy, technical institutions, surveying and an exploration tradition.

name: Blaxmar
description: One of the three closely related peoples of Koplin 3. Blaxmar ancestral physiology is adapted to cold environments, while coal networks, communal survival and Dark Life strongly shaped their history.
